# Jontri

> Jontri is a done-for-you AI automation company. We set up and manage AI systems that answer calls, generate leads, and get businesses found online, so owners capture more revenue with less busywork.

## Services
- AI Voice Agent: a 24/7 AI receptionist that answers calls, qualifies callers, books appointments, and transfers urgent calls.
- AI Lead Prospecting: daily lists of qualified prospects, researched and scored by AI, with personalized outreach.
- AI Website Chatbot: a chatbot trained on the business that answers questions and captures leads after hours.
- Review Management: automated review requests and AI-drafted review replies.
- SEO & AI Search Visibility: Google SEO plus visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- Follow-Up & Custom Workflows: automated follow-up sequences, quoting, reporting, and custom n8n workflows.

Services are offered as three monthly packages (AI Lead Engine, AI Operations Suite, Full AI Transformation) or individually.

## How it works
1. Discovery: review current operations and find where AI can help most.
2. Strategy: a custom automation plan with ROI projections.
3. Implementation: build and integrate the systems with existing tools.
4. Optimization: ongoing monitoring, tuning, and scaling.
